tools.name: calamari_list_employees
tools.description: List one page of employees with their profile, team, position and contract. Use the returned totalPages to read further pages. Calamari: POST /employees/v1/list.

tools.name: calamari_search_employees
tools.description: Find employees by one identifier, or by contract type, position or team. Calamari: POST /employees/v1/search.

tools.name: calamari_list_teams
tools.description: List the teams with their id and name. Calamari: POST /teams/v1/all.

tools.name: calamari_list_positions
tools.description: List the job positions with their id and name. Calamari: POST /positions/v1/all.

tools.name: calamari_list_contract_types
tools.description: List the contract types with their id and name. Calamari: POST /contract-types/v1/all.

tools.name: calamari_list_working_weeks
tools.description: List the working-week schedules (working days per week). Calamari: POST /working-week/v1/all.

tools.name: calamari_list_absence_types
tools.description: List the absence types (leave, sick, remote work) with their id and duration unit. Calamari: POST /leave/v1/get-absence-types.

tools.name: calamari_find_absence_requests
tools.description: List one employee's absence requests in a date range (ISO dates). Calamari: POST /leave/request/v1/find.

tools.name: calamari_find_absence_requests_advanced
tools.description: List absence requests in a date range, filtered by absence type, team or position. Calamari: POST /leave/request/v1/find-advanced.

tools.name: calamari_get_entitlement_balance
tools.description: Get one employee's balance for one absence type on a date (remaining, used, unlimited flag). Calamari: POST /leave/v1/entitlement-balance/get.

tools.name: calamari_list_entitlement_balances
tools.description: List one employee's balance for every absence type on a date. Calamari: POST /leave/v1/entitlement-balance/all.

tools.name: calamari_find_entitlement_balances
tools.description: List the balances of many employees for one absence type, filtered by team, position, contract type or employee. Calamari: POST /leave/v1/entitlement-balance/get-advanced.

tools.name: calamari_find_holidays
tools.description: List the public holidays that apply to one employee in a date range. Calamari: POST /holiday/v1/find.

tools.name: calamari_list_current_shift_status
tools.description: Show each employee's current shift status (STARTED, STOPPED or BREAK). Calamari: POST /clockin/shift/status/v1/get-current-for-all.

tools.name: calamari_get_current_shift_status
tools.description: Show one employee's current shift status (STARTED, STOPPED or BREAK). Calamari: POST /clockin/shift/status/v1/get-current.

tools.name: calamari_get_presence_report
tools.description: Report who was present in a date range, one page at a time. Use the page number to read further pages. Calamari: POST /clockin/shift/status/v1/presence/report.

tools.name: calamari_list_projects
tools.description: List the time-tracking projects (project types) with their id and name. Calamari: POST /clockin/projects/v1/get-projects.

tools.name: calamari_find_time_entries
tools.description: List timesheet entries in a date range, filtered by team, position or contract type. Calamari: POST /clockin/timesheetentries/v1/find.

tools.name: calamari_find_timesheet_balances
tools.description: Show the worked-time balance (overtime or deficit) in a date range, filtered by team, position or contract type. Calamari: POST /clockin/timesheetentries/v1/balance.

tools.name: calamari_create_absence_request
tools.description: Create an absence request for one employee. This is a real request: it notifies the approvers and uses the employee's balance once approved. Calamari: POST /leave/request/v1/create.

tools.name: calamari_create_team
tools.description: Create a team with its members and managers, given as Calamari person ids. Calamari: POST /teams/v1/create.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: calamari_list_employees, calamari_search_employees, calamari_list_teams, calamari_list_positions, calamari_list_contract_types, calamari_list_working_weeks, calamari_list_absence_types, calamari_find_absence_requests, calamari_find_absence_requests_advanced, calamari_get_entitlement_balance, calamari_list_entitlement_balances, calamari_find_entitlement_balances, calamari_find_holidays, calamari_list_current_shift_status, calamari_get_current_shift_status, calamari_get_presence_report, calamari_list_projects, calamari_find_time_entries · Public sink: calamari_list_employees, calamari_search_employees, calamari_list_teams, calamari_list_positions, calamari_list_contract_types, calamari_list_working_weeks, calamari_list_absence_types, calamari_find_absence_requests, calamari_find_absence_requests_advanced, calamari_get_entitlement_balance, calamari_list_entitlement_balances, calamari_find_entitlement_balances, calamari_find_holidays, calamari_list_current_shift_status, calamari_get_current_shift_status, calamari_get_presence_report, calamari_list_projects, calamari_find_time_entries, calamari_find_timesheet_balances, calamari_create_absence_request, calamari_create_team.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
